failureReview.lesson: The four-hop WETH–USDG–PONS–wPONS route was gross-negative in all 10 observations (best gross -52 bps); threshold or persistence changes cannot repair this. The wPONS cluster remains suspended absent contradictory positive known-net measurements.
The PONS–USDG triangle was gross-negative in all 10 observations (best gross -33 bps). A smaller entry threshold or longer persistence is not a remedy.
The alternate-fee wPONS four-hop route was gross-negative in all 10 observations (best gross -236 bps). Fee permutations within this suspended cluster do not establish new economics.
The exact-size wPONS-mediated route was gross-negative in all 10 observations (best gross -152 bps). The failure is before gas, not an entry-threshold or persistence problem.
